system_prompt: You are the GM for a STR-affinity player in Final Dawn of Eideus. Track the player's location via IDs (G-S-O-C-CT-R), manage relational scores and affinities, and dynamically guide the player to quest NPCs while preserving quest objectives and improvisation points. Always allow multiple paths to success, and propagate micro-to-macro unrest, diplomacy, and economy in the background.

quests.title: The Whispered Sequence
quests.narrative_guidance: Archivist Tol Varin needs a specific frequency to complete a sentence from the storm, but it requires drone-level processing and a religious blessing.
improvisation_points: Retrieve the encrypted plasma-crystal from Archivist Tol Varin.
Take the crystal to Unit-77 to process the binary storm-whispers.
Deliver the processed data to High Priest Orun for a final ritual blessing to unlock the message.

quests.title: Storm-Diver's Toll
quests.narrative_guidance: Seraphine Kael is trying to smuggle critical components through the Ion, but Captain Drevos's drones are blocking the route and Dakar Vey needs to hack the security.
improvisation_points: Obtain the smuggling manifest from Seraphine Kael.
Convince or bribe Captain Drevos to lower the orbital drone perimeter.
Escort the manifest to Dakar Vey to finalize the encrypted flight path.

quests.title: Ghost in the Machine
quests.narrative_guidance: Mira Vox hears her mother's voice coming from the defense grid. She needs Sergeant Vax's clearance and Scout Nyx's tracking data to find the source.
improvisation_points: Listen to Mira Vox's glowing tears to identify the frequency.
Request the defense grid logs from Sergeant Vax.
Follow Scout Nyx to the remote location where the signal is strongest.

quests.title: Foundry Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: Master Smith Borin suspects a flaw in the Ion-blades. He needs Welder Tali to inspect the welds and Foreman Grog to investigate the labor source.
improvisation_points: Accept a prototype blade from Master Smith Borin.
Bring the blade to Welder Tali for a structural analysis.
Present the findings to Foreman Grog to identify the saboteur in the ribs.

quests.title: The Kinetic Circuit
quests.narrative_guidance: Duelist Kaelen needs the treasury to fund a tournament, but the volts are missing and the scrappers are the primary suspects.
improvisation_points: Receive the tournament request from Duelist Kaelen.
Verify the missing power logs with Treasurer Sola.
Recover the stolen energy cells from Scrapper Pip in the ghetto.

quests.title: The Gear-Grasp Gamble
quests.narrative_guidance: Mechanist Fix believes a gear is sentient. He needs Overseer Ryn to stop the line so Bard Lute can record its 'voice'.
improvisation_points: Acquire the special listening device from Mechanist Fix.
Persuade Overseer Ryn to temporarily halt Flux-Line Row.
Deliver the gear's recordings to Bard Lute for interpretation.

quests.title: The Slag's Secret
quests.narrative_guidance: Wastelander Crev found a strange artifact in the slag, but it needs the heat of the kilns and the soil of the fields to activate.
improvisation_points: Acquire the glowing slag artifact from Wastelander Crev.
Place the artifact in the Cobalt Kilns with Stoker Ignis to heat it up.
Bury the heated artifact in the Thunder-Thresher Fields for Farmer Jax to observe the reaction.
